stays.name: Windamere Hotel
stays.blurb: A Raj-era hotel on Observatory Hill that began life in 1841 as Ada Villa. Guests stay in cottage-style rooms, and the hotel takes enquiries and bookings directly.

photo.alt: The garden stairway and the Windamere sign on Observatory Hill
photo.author: P.K. Niyogi

pricing.detail: Preferred double or twin room on the CP plan (room with breakfast), before 18% tax. Other rooms and cottages cost more, up to ₹78,000 for the two-bedroom Tinkerbelle's Cottage. Rates are 25% higher on 24, 25, 26 and 31 December.

stays.name: The Elgin, Darjeeling
stays.area: Central Darjeeling, a short walk from the town centre
stays.blurb: A manor house built in 1887, once the summer residence of the Maharaja of Cooch Behar. Today it is a heritage resort with a spa, the Timber Bar and the Orchid Dining Room.

photo.alt: Green-roofed colonial buildings of the Elgin hotel among tall trees
photo.author: Adam Jones

stays.name: Glenburn Tea Estate
stays.blurb: A working tea estate with a small set of named bungalow suites and rooms, plus a lodge and campsite. Guests can see how the tea is made.

photo.alt: Kangchenjunga and the Himalayan range seen from Glenburn Tea Estate
photo.caption: Kangchenjunga seen from the estate
photo.author: A. J. T. Johnsingh, WWF-India and NCF

pricing.detail: All-inclusive package: all meals, airport or station transfers, guided activities and tea tastings, before 18% GST. ₹30,200 for one person.

stays.name: Singell Tea Estate (CGH Earth)
stays.blurb: A stay built around a 100-year-old planter's bungalow on a tea estate planted in 1871. Rooms include heritage rooms and a room with a solarium, and guests can join tea tastings and factory visits.

stays.name: Hotel Seven Seventeen
stays.blurb: A traditional Tibetan-style hotel on H.D. Lama Road in the middle of town, with 23 rooms.
